description: SECURITY (s441, F5). An inline event handler tests a server-function call as a condition: `onclick=${ if (isOk(1)) {…} else {…} }`. The server answers false, so the click MUST take the else branch ("rejected"). Before s441 an inline handler was lowered through the string rewriter and never reached the function-body auto-await: the handler emitted `if (isOk(1))`, a Promise, always truthy — "accepted" for every input. The handler now awaits the call (and runs async).
rationale: §13.2: the compiler SHALL insert `await` at every call site where a server-generated fetch call is made — including an inline event-handler value (ruling S440 JS-WAT #11: handler bodies are subject to every rule).
